meta_description:
3,262 likes, 11 comments - chitwangarg on September 23, 2026: "FIRST TIME EVERRRR - Pink Guava Chia Pudding 🍈🥣

Serves: 1
~390 kcal | ~39 g protein

Ingredients
Ace Blend Pink Guava Protein Powder - 1 scoop
Cold water - 120–150 ml
Chia seeds - 2½ tbsp
Fresh pink guava - ½ (sliced)
Sunflower seeds - 1 tsp
Roasted flax seeds - ½ tsp
Pumpkin seeds - 1 tsp
Date syrup - ½ tsp

Method
1. In a bowl, mix guava flavour protein powder with cold water until smooth.
2. Add chia seeds and mix well.
3. Refrigerate until the chia seeds absorb the liquid and the mixture thickens.
4. Top with sliced pink guava, sunflower seeds, roasted flax seeds and pumpkin seeds.
5. Drizzle with date syrup and enjoy chilled! 🍈✨

I’ve used @ace.blend Pink Guava Protein to make this chia pudding, it gives the recipe a delicious guava flavour while adding 30 g of plant protein in one serving.
